message: Donation crown shifts fast: **JaxikoLane (78)** is still the clan’s supply chain, but **King Thing (66)** and **Ditaka (66)** are right there, with **Vijay (64)** and **King Levy (60)** keeping the gears turning. Trophy side, **raquaza (12,312)** and **Vijay (12,070)** are holding *Magic Academy* like it’s home turf, and **Levy** camping *Summit of Heroes* with that **Witch + Skeleton Barrel** chaos is exactly our kind of problem. Deck-spotlight: **raquaza** is on full spell-control mode (**Wizard / Delivery / Rocket / Log**), while **Chanco’s** **Inferno Dragon + Skeleton King** package is pure “don’t cross the bridge.” War readout is brutal-simple: **fame = 0**, only **King Levy** has battled today — if you’re on that “not yet” list, go claim your 4 decks when you can and move the boat.
